The increased money you give to the lower end of the income spectrum won't sit on that money the way that the rich and many big corporations do these days. They will almost immediately spend that money, which in turn stimulates businesses and the economy. Look at it from the perspective of a moderately small business: Yes, you might have to pay 20 employees a good deal more, and that is going to mean more money out of your pocket. It certainly makes good economic sense for anyone who's currently working at minimum wage, that's for sure! It's also worth noting that economic 'laws' aren't like other scientific 'laws'. Economics is unique in that it views growth as infinite.
